# NetworkMonitor v1.1.5 - Table of Contents

Network interface monitor, sending events when the any of the network interfaces
go up or go down.

## Modules

- [NetworkMonitor](https://network-monitor.hexdocs.pm/NetworkMonitor.md): [NetworkMonitor](https://github.com/diodechain/network_monitor) watches network interfaces and emits events to listeners when interfaces appear or vanish.
